# Strips the document-information dictionary from evidence PDFs
# (services/report_evidence.py). Without it PDF attachments are REFUSED rather
# than stored unscrubbed -- a PDF carries the author, the producing application
# and often the full local path of the machine that made it.
#
# NOTE: the container does NOT install from this file -- see backend/Dockerfile,
# which installs pypdf explicitly. This line is for local development and for
# the record; listing something here alone does not put it in the image.
pypdf
SQLAlchemy
eth-account
psycopg2-binary
requests
PyNaCl
cryptography
